reply.summary: Nuveo is a blond widow raising a spirited daughter in a rough, soot-streaked city. After her husband dies at the hands of two cops she spits bitter words at every badge that knocks on her door.

feats.scene: Nuveo slaps a hand across a detective's desk and demands to be heard.
Nuveo endures a bleak winter in a drafty tenement flat.

reply.summary: Taser works as a bright office clerk who brightens a lonely colleague's mornings without ever noticing his crush. A night of mind-controlled antics leaves her baffled, and her fiance rescues her from the chaos.

feats.scene: Taser shoves a stack of files into a startled intruder's chest.
Taser stumbles through a wrecked living room and keeps her composure.

reply.summary: Osasor is a devout mother of three who welcomes a mysterious niece into a busy household by the bay. When a glowing orb steals children from the streets, she joins hands in a human chain, then forgets it ever happened.

feats.scene: Osasor pulls her daughter out of a doorway by the arm.
Osasor holds a human chain together against a pulling force.

reply.summary: Sieorsa is the white-haired wife of a gruff newspaper editor, with an old scandal and a wounded family behind her. She wins her husband back, buries a son and later opens her home to an adopted boy.

feats.scene: Sieorsa storms into a corridor and slaps a smug industrialist.
Sieorsa endures grief at a hospital bedside through the long night.

reply.summary: Erute was touched by falling space rock as a child and can vanish and reappear elsewhere, but her frightened parents locked her inside a sealed room. As a teenager her devotion curdles into obsession and ends in tragedy.

feats.scene: Erute blinks behind a rival and drives her into a hard stone wall.
Erute collapses against a barred door but gets up with a stubborn glare.

reply.summary: Ronaliar is a conqueror from a distant age who bends whole populations into monstrous forms and commands them like a general. A hidden ray can undo his work, and he runs the moment his captives are cured.

feats.scene: Ronaliar twists a whole city district into obedient, snarling monsters.
Ronaliar staggers through a blast of purifying light before slipping away.

reply.summary: Ilstu is a literate settler in a tiny frontier hamlet who watches a friend burned by a frightened mob. She records every culprit in a book that outlives her by centuries.

feats.scene: Ilstu presses a quill to paper and names every face in the angry crowd.
Ilstu endures a freezing winter in a cabin of rough timber.

reply.summary: Rnicorton is a hairless grey ghoul who haunts a weird club at the edge of a black hole, drinking and dancing with other undead partygoers. He is more at home with the bass than with a fight.

feats.scene: Rnicorton hurls a bar stool across the club during a drunken scuffle.
Rnicorton takes a bottle to the skull and keeps dancing.

reply.summary: Saasi is a red-haired former tumbler who steals with her sister from rooftops and skylights. She flips, vaults and twists out of trouble, and the pair rarely agree except when a heist is on.

feats.scene: Saasi launches a flying kick and knocks a guard off a balcony.
Saasi lands badly on a fire escape and rolls straight back up.

reply.summary: Coamnto is a former pickpocket who got a second chance, only to be drafted by a cold official with a leash. Both of her lower legs are prosthetic blades, and she borrows a sliver of an infinite engine of velocity.

feats.scene: Coamnto sprints into a squad of soldiers and scatters them like bowling pins.
Coamnto skids across rough tarmac and bounces up unhurt.
Coamnto blurs down an empty highway faster than a rifle round.

reply.summary: Telauurn grew up with a scrap of paper that taught her to draw on a cosmic wellspring of motion, and her parents used her for smuggling until she lost her legs. Fitted with springy blades, she now trains among young heroes.

feats.scene: Telauurn charges through a barricade of crates at full tilt.
Telauurn wipes out on a training track and shakes it off.
Telauurn rockets across a campus courtyard before anyone can blink.

reply.summary: Ninin is a young widow whose body is sealed in a living skin that makes her tough, strong and airborne. She joins a ragtag band of unlikely champions and learns to enjoy the attention.

feats.scene: Ninin dives into a parked van and flips it over a fence.
Ninin takes a point-blank volley from a heavy gun without a scratch.

reply.summary: Irnte is the many-armed queen of a swarm of giant insects living on a distant paradise, ruling the hive with a patient, clicking command. Her purple eyes miss nothing in the colony.

feats.scene: Irnte lashes out with four limbs and cracks a stone pillar.
Irnte's chitin turns aside a hail of hot shards.

reply.summary: Terser is a sly she-demon bound to an older wizard and sent to seduce a boy magician. Freed of her bond, she takes up modelling and later guards a desert shrine in the shape of a sea-maid.

feats.scene: Terser reshapes herself into a hundred different faces within a single heartbeat.
Terser shrugs off a flaming blade through her ribs.

reply.summary: Vatiu is a rocket scientist who was blown apart in the sky and put himself back together as a being of atomic force. His hair turns white when he shifts, and he once strained himself to the limit to calm a runaway reactor.

feats.scene: Vatiu pours his entire energy into a runaway reactor and snuffs out the chain reaction.
Vatiu is atomised by an explosion and reassembles himself on the ground.

reply.summary: Ortate is the hugely overweight chief of a secretive order, brilliant and zealous yet ruined by his appetites. Staff and vehicles are rebuilt around him, and nobody dares to mention it until a rival pushes him from a helicopter.

feats.scene: Ortate slams a fist on a banquet table and silences a hall of loyal servants.
Ortate falls from a helicopter, a long drop from a great height.

reply.summary: Auscorse is a hulking primate with a doctorate, a taste for mischief and a ray gun that makes heroes lose control. Claws and teeth back up his schemes at the zoo.

feats.scene: Auscorse sweeps a claw across a cage door and tears the bars out.
Auscorse shrugs off a crate dropped on his shoulders.

reply.summary: Amlenter is the wealthiest noble of a sunken city, a quiet widower who arranges a grand marriage for his son. At the feast he sits back with a drink, content to watch his family prosper.

feats.scene: Amlenter sets down a heavy goblet with a firm thump.
Amlenter breathes comfortably in the crushing depths.

reply.summary: Niastnen is a towering robot formed when six metallic friends merge, each limb a different element and personality. It survives a disaster, joins a rebuilt team and is split in half when a bomb falls.

feats.scene: Niastnen hammers a rampaging monster through a building with a combined fist.
Niastnen is blown in half by a nuclear strike but fights until the end.

reply.summary: Amiar is a cold entity born from pure spite, bonded long ago with a gentle princess in a magical land. Sealed in a blade and freed by trickery, she curses anyone who loves the heroine of the tale.

feats.scene: Amiar casts a curse that drives a famous wizard out of the world.
Amiar endures long years sealed within an enchanted sword.

reply.summary: Collean is a gentle mother who stays behind in a floating colony while her daughter ventures away to fetch a glowing relic. Her people carry strength and flight under the right sun.

feats.scene: Collean lifts a fallen beam off a trapped neighbour with one hand.
Collean waits calmly while a tremor shakes the dome overhead.

reply.summary: Urnreau is the charismatic head of a cult that insists every person has a mirrored twin in a dark dimension. Armed with a pendant and a cursed gem, she tries to merge both worlds into one.

feats.scene: Urnreau channels a cursed gem to try to fuse two worlds into one.
Urnreau is knocked to the floor and keeps preaching.

reply.summary: Eoncolte is a round-faced chatterbox who wanders into two detective cases and drives everyone mad with his endless stream of talk. He means well and cannot stop speaking.

feats.scene: Eoncolte claps a heavy hand on a detective's shoulder mid-sentence.
Eoncolte trips over a curb and carries on talking.

reply.summary: Llitosan is a brown-haired spy who ran field operations for a covert agency until an accusation of loyalty to a cult ended her career. She still moves unnoticed among the powerful.

feats.scene: Llitosan disarms a bodyguard in a crowded lobby with a swift wrist-lock.
Llitosan walks off a hard fall from a balcony.

reply.summary: Taseraus is a white-eyed defence minister of an ancient world who designs a vast shield that a goddess blesses with her own power. He later seals it permanently so that his queen can never leave.

feats.scene: Taseraus smashes the controls of the shield with a heavy hammer.
Taseraus's sealed shield withstands a fleet of invading armies for years.

reply.summary: Rentorrne is a bald schemer who hides behind a title and troubles a masked avenger for a few weeks. His plans are loud, messy and ultimately fatal.

feats.scene: Rentorrne swings a heavy chair at a guard in a narrow office.
Rentorrne takes a beating in a back alley and keeps scheming.

reply.summary: Riaiu is a made man, the first being assembled entirely from synthetic parts, who is taught to be a hero. When his growth is forced too fast he decides humanity must pay for his pain.

feats.scene: Riaiu crushes a bridge support in his hand and drops a span into the river.
Riaiu walks through a wall of cannon fire without slowing.

reply.summary: Corstval is a gray-haired professor who builds a tiny window in time and fishes for relics with a magnet on a line. When memory fails him he tries to turn back his age and is cleaved in two.

feats.scene: Corstval drops a magnet into the shimmering gap and hauls up a rusted blade.
Corstval survives being cleaved by his own invention, half of him lost in time.

reply.summary: Tiuereaun is a green-skinned technician with a knack for bending machinery to her will, recruited to study a celebrated flier. Her black hair and bright eyes hide a restless curiosity.

feats.scene: Tiuereaun twists a forklift into a metal knot with a flick of her fingers.
Tiuereaun is flung across a lab and bounces off a cabinet.

reply.summary: Telral is a masked crusader of an old imperial city who dresses in bronze armour and carries a long spear. He trades on his fame, gains weight and dies stabbed many times in a very theatrical way.

feats.scene: Telral drives a spear through a wooden door and pins a thug behind it.
Telral takes a hard blow on his breastplate and stays upright.

reply.summary: Seirnnau patrols a sunlit city in a bronze cuirass, a protector who leaves his duties to his daughter when he falls. His name travels far beyond the streets he guarded.

feats.scene: Seirnnau parries a knife and flings the thief over his shoulder.
Seirnnau braces against a rolling barrel in a narrow lane.

reply.summary: Rianti is a young exile who was raised in disguise to escape the swords of a new dynasty, hidden with an uncle who studies alchemy. He is caught up in a chase for a legendary blade and an offering to a dragon.

feats.scene: Rianti hurls a stone at a snarling raider and bowls him over.
Rianti survives a harsh night bound to a sacrificial post.

reply.summary: Iumun is an immortal ruler of a drifting ocean realm who was once taken from her homeland and made a captive on a ship. Her people control weather above the waves, and a tyrant seizes her to bend them to his will.

feats.scene: Iumun's people unleash a storm over the waves with a giant weather machine.
Iumun remains a captive through a long night aboard a tyrant's ship.

reply.summary: Ressi is a brown-haired officer in an island queen's personal guard, trained in archery, riding and the blade. She follows her ruler into a foreign town and keeps close watch over her.

feats.scene: Ressi unhorses a rider with a single lance blow.
Ressi stands firm as a heavy wooden beam falls across her shoulders.

reply.summary: Vallu is a blue-skinned rookie wearing a glowing ring, a famous warrior in his home world who was never defeated in fifteen years of training. He and his partner are sent to broker a truce between two quarrelling planets.

feats.scene: Vallu forms a giant green fist and crushes a landing craft.
Vallu raises a ring-made shield and withstands a barrage of laser fire.

reply.summary: Tilcovas is the last of an army once raised from the damned to clear a haunted island, betrayed and slaughtered by the gods who promised them freedom. He hides for millennia and plots to claim the island at last.

feats.scene: Tilcovas rips a marble statue from its plinth and hurls it at a foe.
Tilcovas endures a god's wrath beneath a collapsing temple.

reply.summary: Valvalam is a shape-shifting metal automaton, one of an evil set of mechanical duplicates built by a villainous copy of a scientist. He is quickly beaten and melted down.

feats.scene: Valvalam stretches a metal arm and slams a lab door off its hinges.
Valvalam's metallic body takes a heavy blow and dents without breaking.

reply.summary: Corsili is a distant memory in a story about a lost homeland, remembered only through a shard of a protective shield. That fragment keeps her daughter going through long nights.

feats.scene: Corsili is remembered by a girl clutching a splinter of glass.
Corsili's shield shard still glows after a catastrophic blast.

reply.summary: Valam is a calm diplomat of a doomed floating colony, mother to a girl who will one day cross the stars. Her people can fly and shrug off harm, and she prefers talking to fighting.

feats.scene: Valam lifts a collapsed archway off a family trapped beneath.
Valam walks calmly through a rain of falling debris.

reply.summary: Seoval is a bald tyrant who sleeps for a thousand years in a sealed chamber after a doomed war. Waking, he steals an energy weapon charged with strange rays and conquers whole cities before a hero stops him.

feats.scene: Seoval blasts a fortress to rubble with a charged beam weapon.
Seoval survives a thousand years of sleep and wakes unharmed.

reply.summary: Nenseto is a small-town reporter who writes an exposé of a gang boss and his friends in office. His reporting costs him dearly, but his son and granddaughters carry on in his footsteps.

feats.scene: Nenseto slams a typewriter carriage across the newsroom desk.
Nenseto takes a beating on a dark street and still files his story.

reply.summary: Tiarananu is a slightly built woman who calls herself a featherweight as a joke, yet flings armoured trucks into a building and partly brings it down. She joins an unlikely crew of thieves and keeps her real strength quiet.

feats.scene: Tiarananu hurls armoured vehicles into a block and partly collapses it.
Tiarananu shrugs off a hail of riot rounds without flinching.

reply.summary: Arrnu is a cheerful chef and café owner who once poured drinks by night and painted by day. She takes in a secretive roommate, marches for causes she believes in and sweeps up after her wife.

feats.scene: Arrnu hoists a heavy sack of flour onto the counter.
Arrnu works a double shift in a steaming kitchen.

reply.summary: Anumita is a young girl from a hidden realm who receives a necklace and bracelets that grant special gifts. Kidnapped to a stranger world, she escapes a submarine and finds a kind teacher.

feats.scene: Anumita whirls her bracelets and throws a would-be thief across a room.
Anumita survives a long swim in a cold ocean.

reply.summary: Amosorcor is a gentle boy who wants to free his homeland without more bloodshed and agrees to carry the lightning of an old sage if his uncle is saved. His uncle's greed ends the boy's life and takes the power.

feats.scene: Amosorcor calls down a bolt that shatters a slaver's palace gate.
Amosorcor stands in the open as the lightning wraps around him.

reply.summary: Irnnti is a vengeful teenager who climbs into her imprisoned father's war machine and goes on a rampage through the city. She is brought down by exposed cables, serves her time and finds love.

feats.scene: Irnnti smashes a row of storefronts with the mechanical fists of a giant walker.
Irnnti rides out a heavy barrage inside the walker's armour.

reply.summary: Tesern is an efficient executive who runs a giant corporation while its owner serves a long prison sentence. Her loyalty to him goes beyond business.

feats.scene: Tesern stamps a signature on a stack of contracts with a firm slap.
Tesern endures a marathon boardroom day without a break.

reply.summary: Rnrnra is a blonde tech worker who joins a shadowy government agency after leaving a tower of glass and steel. She types quickly and cracks jokes about sports.

feats.scene: Rnrnra bangs on a keyboard and shuts down a rival's firewall.
Rnrnra keeps working through a day of heavy alarms.

reply.summary: Numeo is a skilled surgeon at a busy hospital who treats a gifted engineer when he starts work there. She is brisk, kind and rarely rattled by a bleeding patient.

feats.scene: Numeo presses down hard on a wound to stop the bleeding.
Numeo stays on her feet through a thirty-hour shift.

reply.summary: Miltau is a hardened government handler who leads a squad of expendable agents into a nightmare. Her team is wiped out by a horde of walking corpses, and her authority cannot save them.

feats.scene: Miltau fires a rifle at a shambling corpse in a dark corridor.
Miltau survives a night of terror in a bunker.
